test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given pie chart shows the monthly savings and expenditure incurred by a family on various items. Study the chart and answer the question given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b004ed4272b29e2826912914fcdea56a515cea3f30f3556c0db7e880b84760.png] 

If the monthly savings are Rs. 5,000, then the total expenditure on education and clothing is:
solution:
let the total income is Rs.x

10% of x = 5000

⇒ x = (5000 × 100)/10

⇒ x = 50,000

Expenses on education = 20% of 50,000

⇒ 10,000

expenses on clothing = 9% of 50,000

⇒ 4500

**∴ Total expenditure on education and clothing is 14,500 i.e. (10,000 + 4500)**
